label: Remnant star cruiser
note: IP-neutral. Issue #876: the red system's Remnant star cruiser, the same ship as the home planet's and the belt's (everything not listed here is remnant_cruiser.json's: its pads and parked ships, how Z docks you, the crew, the droids, the general, the escort). It holds station in the red desert world's sky, past the ring station's bay mouth: where is port_red's 'red_cruiser' landmark (content/core/planets/port_red.json). As the belt cruiser it is not the story's: killing its general sets only its own flag (WorldState 'red_cruiser_taken', saved with the world) and pays its own reward; the home cruiser, the belt cruiser, Oda's story and the dark master are untouched. Once taken the locals crew it (remnant_cruiser.json's 'holders'), and it is still there to fly to and walk round. Its escort meets you when you climb out of the port's sky flying for it (nose within approach.cone_deg of it, or already within dock.radius of it); climbing out any other way meets the planet's own skirmish.

holo.note: The bridge's holo table shows the red system's world under it (CruiserHolo.setup_system): the red desert ball (radius metres on the table, lines of latitude and longitude bands apart; it has no ring), the ring station on its orbit over the port (a small model station_width long, at least station_over metres off the ball, a bead station_bead over it), and this cruiser where it really is (heights squeezed by squeeze), each coloured by who holds it (owner_colors: the station's Remnant deck, Territory 'station_dark_station'; the cruiser the Remnant's until its general dies, then empty) and named under its label (lines.owners), recoloured live. It spins slowly (spin_deg_s) about the ball's up.
